[page[title]]

An aggregation service may have any number of dependencies, but they must share the same service variation.

What the Standard says

“No Dependency Limitation” — Aggregation services may consume several dependencies because their purpose is to provide one abstraction at the edge of the business layer. read it here.
“Pure Dependency Contracts” — Those dependencies must share the same input contract so the aggregation remains cohesive instead of coordinating unrelated business flows. read it here.

Why it matters

Aggregation exists to combine multiple variations of the same service capability. Depending on unrelated services would turn it into general orchestration and erase the reason the layer has stronger transactional and exception-handling expectations.

Bad code example

// Violates STXA001: An aggregation service may have any number of dependencies, but they must share the same service variation.
class StudentAggregationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseProcessingService courses) : IStudentAggregationService { }

Good code example

// Follows STXA001
class StudentAggregationService(
    IStudentService students,
    ICourseService courses) : IStudentAggregationService { }
